steps.label: 3300-own-lab-actual239-fill-saved-json-inputs
command: (()=>{if(location.pathname!=='/lab/view/omr-render.donga'||document.querySelector('#omrTypeSel').value!=='OBSACN')throw Error('Actual OBSACN Lab type');const f=window.__qaLabSavedOmrFixtures?.find(e=>e.itemId===2089239);if(!f||f.questionType!=='OBSACN'||f.omr[0]?.options?.length!==5)throw Error('Expected actual saved five-choice fixture');for(const [id,value] of [['omrJsonIn',f.omr],['ansJsonIn',f.answer]]){const e=document.getElementById(id);e.value=JSON.stringify(value);e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true}));}return {sourceItemId:f.itemId,type:f.questionType,omrCharacters:document.querySelector('#omrJsonIn').value.length,answerCharacters:document.querySelector('#ansJsonIn').value.length};})()
